title: story CLI users authenticate and manage cloud scores
description:
As an Apricity user, I want to sign in from the CLI and manage my cloud Scores, so that I can publish and maintain .apr work without using the browser.

Feature: Authenticated cloud CLI

Scenario: A signed-out user publishes a score
Given the user has no CLI session
When they run `apricity login` and complete Google authorization
And they run `apricity score create beat.apr`
Then Apricity creates a Score and its extracted ScoreRefs under that user identity
And prints the score ID without printing credentials

Scenario: A curator imports the library records
Given the signed-in user belongs to both admins and curators
When they run `apricity sample import`
Then Apricity mirrors existing storage record files into AppSync in dependency order

Scenario: An unauthorized user imports records
Given the signed-in user lacks admin or curator membership
When they run `apricity sample import`
Then Apricity refuses before it changes cloud records
